source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: You may use this ability on selecting the C’tan to Advance during your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase). Its **[Advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)** has unlimited reach and may pass through any model. Enemy models count, as do models with **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE**. The C’tan must finish beyond 8″ of every enemy unit, measured horizontally.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
